title: Configuring Supplier Trade Schemes (Buy 10 Get 1 Free)
role: Inventory Controllers, Purchase Managers & Store Owners

intro.title: Supplier Trade Schemes
intro.subtitle: Set up automated Buy X Get Y bonus units, volume trade discounts, and diluted landed cost calculations

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 4, Part 8: Configuring Supplier Trade Schemes, like Buy 10 Get 1 Free. Trade schemes automate bonus unit calculations during inward purchasing and counter sales.
Navigate to Settings, then Trade Schemes. Click Create New Scheme to open the promotion configuration builder.
Select the Buy X Get Y promotion card. Enter a scheme title, set the Buy Quantity to 10, and Free Quantity to 1.
Choose the target scope: Apply it store-wide, by therapeutic drug category, or target a specific medicine like Paracetamol 650.
Save the scheme. The deal is immediately active across MediFlow, automatically computing bonus units and diluted landed costs in GRNs. This concludes Phase 4!

outro.takeaway: Trade Schemes: Automate Buy X Get Y bonus inventory, prevent manual calculator errors, and accurately track net landed costs during purchasing.
